a: Cursors should be opaque tokens, not raw offsets.
Stable sort orders make pagination predictable.
Allow clients to select fields to reduce payload size.
Enable gzip/br compression for large JSON responses.
Strong validators change on any difference; weak allow equivalence.
private caches are user-specific; public can be shared.
Vary tells caches which request headers affect the response.
Serve stale content briefly while refreshing in background.
Open circuit rejects calls until a trial period succeeds.
Bulkheads isolate resources so failures stay contained.
